en.general: Humans exist within geological, evolutionary, and cultural timescales that dwarf individual lifespans. Students build intuitions for deep time across all strands.

extensions.oe:fullStatement: CROSS-CUTTING THEME 1 -- Deep Time and Scale: Humans exist within geological, evolutionary, and cultural timescales that dwarf individual lifespans. Students build intuitions for deep time across all strands, from personal family history (K-2) to molecular clocks and coalescent theory (9-12).

oe:strandActivation.activationNote: Primary strand -- geological and evolutionary timelines of hominin evolution
Molecular clock inference; coalescent theory; population divergence dates
Rates of molecular evolution; mutation accumulation across generations
Language family divergence times; deep history of oral traditions
